g.title: CRANK_HALL
g.text: 60-2 missing tooth Hall effect — MaxxECU TRIGGER input (Digital/Hall, N-1 trigger type)

OE# 07K906433B (Hall sensor — confirmed Valeo 366675 / Bremi 60319 datasheets). Connector body OE# 3B0973703G — same body as CAM_HALL but DIFFERENT pinout. Crank: +5V / Signal / Sensor GND (Hall). Cam: +5V / Sensor GND / Signal (Hall). ⚠️ LABEL PIGTAILS AT CRIMP TIME — identical housing, opposite signal/GND pinout! Swapped pigtails → no-start with no obvious failure indicator. MTune: Trigger Input = "Digital (Hall, opto, etc)" — NOT VR sensor. Trigger system: N-1 / 60-2 missing tooth. ME7.1.1 harness ref: Conn B pin 82. Direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU: pin1(+5V)→CMC G1(pin 25); pin2(signal)→ CMC H3(pin 31, TRIGGER); pin3(SensorGND)→CMC H1(pin 29). Location: cylinder 5 side — sensor G28 at timing chain compartment cover. Source: charm.li CBTA/BGP component locations, item 12.

g.title: W_CRANK
g.text: Hall effect sensor — 3-wire active (not shielded twisted pair like M52 VR). RD=+5V supply → CMC G1 (pin 25). WH=Hall signal → CMC H3 (pin 31, TRIGGER). BN=Sensor GND → CMC H1 (pin 29). Direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU. Shielded cable still recommended for noise immunity; if shielded, drain at ECU-end BN.

g.title: ECU_CMC
g.text: A1: GPO 5 (Rev light relay — Ph3 reassignment; ICV B freed)
B1: GPO 6 (FAN — CAN cmd → PMU16 O3)
C4: GPO 2 (Fuel pump — CAN cmd → PMU16 O4)
H2: Trigger GND (VR-) [M52 only — UNUSED for 07K Hall crank]

g.title: CAM_HALL
g.text: Hall effect, intake side top of head — +5V supply type (not +12V)

TODO: Confirm exact VW connector body type at install. ME7.1.1 harness ref: pin 86. +5V supply shared with MAP/TPS/PST-F1 on CMC G1 rail. Signal → CMC H4 (HOME, pin 32) — direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU.

g.title: W_CAM
g.text: +5V from shared sensor rail (CMC G1, pin 25). Shielded recommended — cam Hall signal is sensitive to coil primary noise. Shield drain terminates at CMC E3 (GND Shield, pin 19) at the ECU end. Float at sensor side.

g.title: CLT
g.text: NTC thermistor — cylinder 1 side, exhaust face of block

ME7.1.1 ref: pin 93. TODO: verify VW-specific 2-pin connector housing at engine. BGP source: the07k.wiki/upload/f/fd/BGP_Wiring_diagram.pdf (Diagram 4, "right rear"). Location: cylinder 1 side + exhaust side. In E36: front of engine, exhaust face. Route pigtail with heat sleeving (exhaust manifold adjacent).

g.title: IAT
g.text: NTC thermistor — airbox or intake pipe
Mount in intake pipe downstream of intercooler. TODO: confirm connector body at install.

g.title: MAP
g.text: Same sensor as M52 phase, upgrade to 3-bar if still on stock 1-bar. Route vacuum hose to BBG intake manifold (post-throttle body) for boost-corrected MAP.

g.title: DBW_TB
g.text: Stock ~65mm bore. Upgrade to VR6 03H133062 74mm for 600+ whp.

TODO: Confirm VW TB connector body and motor wire polarity at install. ME7.1.1 ref: Motor+=pin84, Motor-=pin92, TPS1=pin117, TPS2=pin118. MaxxECU ETh1 motor: C2 H4 (MOTOR 1+) → TB Motor+; C2 H2 (MOTOR 1-) → TB Motor-. NOT GPO3/GPO4. C2 MOTOR 1+/1- are the correct H-bridge outputs. Direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU — no firewall crossing. Source: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout (maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html). MTune: Settings → E-Throttle → Motor output → Motor 1. IMPORTANT: verify motor polarity with volt meter before wiring — swap Motor+/- at TB connector if throttle runs in wrong direction during e-throttle wizard. TPS1 → CMC G2 (pin 26). TPS2 → CMC J2 (AIN 2, pin 34). +5V → CMC G1 (pin 25, shared +5V rail). GND → CMC H1 (pin 29, SGND). Calibrate in MTune :: Throttle :: E-Throttle wizard.

g.title: W_DBW_MOTOR
g.text: ECU_C2:4:H4: MOTOR 1+ — ETh Motor+ → TB motor (direct-terminate engine-bay)
ECU_C2:5:H2: MOTOR 1- — ETh Motor- → TB motor (direct-terminate engine-bay)

22 AWG (3A peak, 0.5 m). Verify polarity at TB before final crimp. Engine-side wires terminate at throttle body motor leads (OE ref: pin 84 Mot+, pin 92 Mot-). ECU-side wires terminate directly at MaxxECU C2 H4/H2 (engine-bay ECU — no bulkhead crossing).

g.title: ECU_C2
g.text: H4: MOTOR 1+ — ETh Motor+ → TB motor (direct-terminate engine-bay)
H2: MOTOR 1- — ETh Motor- → TB motor (direct-terminate engine-bay)

C2 H4 (MOTOR 1+) and C2 H2 (MOTOR 1-) are the dedicated H-bridge outputs for the 07K DBW throttle body. NOT GPO3/4. These wires direct-terminate at the TB motor leads engine-bay-side (ECU is engine-bay per H2O arch — no bulkhead crossing). AIN 6 (C2 E4) and AIN 7 (C2 F1) are used for APS1/APS2 from the E46 pedal -- those wires cross the firewall via Maven Connector B (see harnesses/firewall-crossing-maven.wv). Source: MaxxECU RACE GEN1 C2 pinout (maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-maxxecu_pinout.html). For CPS (clutch position) wiring detail see docs/vendor/dctshifter/DCT_Clutch_Simulator.md.

g.title: KNOCK_1
g.text: Bosch flat knock sensor 1-pin (M8 bolt mount)

GND via M8 mounting bolt to block — no separate GND wire. ME7.1.1 ref: pin 106. MaxxECU: CMC K3 (DIN/VR1, pin 39) — direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU. Shield drain terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND) at the ECU end. Location: "back side of engine block" = exhaust side (both KS1 and KS2). Source: charm.li CBTA/BGP component locations — "Knock Sensors" section.

g.title: W_KNOCK_1
g.text: GND via M8 mounting bolt — no GND wire. Shield drain (wire 2) terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND, pin 29) at the ECU end. Float at sensor side (single-end drain to prevent ground loops). ROUTING: Both KS1/KS2 sensors are on the exhaust side of the block. Route pigtails down the block face, away from the exhaust manifold, then bundle into KNOCK sub-loom across the bottom of the engine. If any section runs within 100 mm (4 in) of exhaust manifold, wrap with DEI Reflect-A-Gold (p/n 010394, 1-1/2"x15' roll, $42.99 — designengineering.com/reflect-a-gold-heat-reflective-tape-1-5-x-15/) over the Techflex sleeve before tie-strapping. Reflect-A-Gold is a metalized polyimide laminated glass cloth, 800°F continuous (adhesive rated 325°F). NOT to be confused with Reflect-A-Cool (fiberglass foil sheet, 400°F).

g.title: KNOCK_2
g.text: Bosch flat knock sensor 1-pin (M8 bolt mount)

GND via M8 mounting bolt. ME7.1.1 ref: pin 107. MaxxECU: CMC K4 (DIN/VR2, pin 40) — direct-terminate at engine-bay ECU. Shield drain terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND) at the ECU end (shared with KS1).

g.title: W_KNOCK_2
g.text: Shield drain terminates at CMC H1 (Sensor GND, pin 29) at the ECU end (shared with KS1 drain). See W_KNOCK_1 for routing and heat management spec.

g.title: ECU_12PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 12-pin power/chassis breakout
Coil/inj relay trigger (pin 2 — N/C, PMU16 O2)
Fuel pump relay trigger (pin 3 — N/C, PMU16 O4)
Coolant fan relay trigger (pin 9 — N/C, PMU16 O3)

g.title: W_VVT_SOL
g.text: 22 AWG (size-22D contact; 22 AWG adequate for solenoid drive current). Flyback diode at solenoid connector. Route in actuators sub-loom with boost solenoid.

g.title: INJ_1
g.text: MaxxECU M50 harness ships with EV1 connector ends — replace with EV14 pigtails for 07K. Product: http://injectordynamics.com/injectors/id1050-xds/

g.title: PST_F1
g.text: Dual oil temp+pressure — iABED M10x1.0 port on 07K oil housing
Same wiring as M52 phase — zero connector or cable changes. Mount: iABED 07K longitudinal oil housing M10x1.0 built-in port. Pressure → AIN 3 (0-5V, 0-10 bar). Temp → AIN 1 (NTC).

g.title: W_PST_F1
g.text: Same cable as M52 build — no change.

g.title: WIDEBAND
g.text: Same ECU-side cable structure as M52 (same 5-wire cable, same CMC channels). Sensor-side pin numbers differ from LSU 4.2 — use pinlabels above, not M52 diagram. Bung: weld 18mm x1.5 in 07K custom top-mount exhaust manifold, min 6in from collector, upstream of turbo. Sensor: Bosch 0 258 017 025 (LSU 4.9). Product: https://www.bosch-motorsport.com/products/sensors/lambda/lambda-sensor-lsu-4-9/ Pin numbering source: maxxecu.com/webhelp/wirings-lambda_sensors.html (LSU 4.9 table). Wire colors: red=IP(1), yellow=VREF(2), white=H-(3), grey=H+(4), green=RCAL(5), black=VS(6). Always verify by wire color — do not rely on pin number alone.

g.title: W_WBO2
g.text: Same wiring as M52. Heater+ (LSU 4.9 pin 4 / H+) splices to local +12V coil rail — see W_WBO2_HTR. Shielded — VS/VREF/IP/RCAL are low-level analog signals susceptible to injector/coil noise. Single-end drain at ECU end only. HEAT MANAGEMENT: Bung is on the custom top-mount exhaust manifold. Sleeve the first 300 mm (12 in) from the sensor body with DEI Fire Sleeve 3/8" ID (p/n 010470, 3/8"x36" kit, $26.99 — designengineering.com/fire-sleeve-tape-kit-0-375-id-x-36/; silicone-over-fiberglass, 500°F/260°C continuous, 2000°F intermittent). Transition to Techflex F6 after clearing the manifold/turbo heat zone. Route away from turbo turbine housing and wastegate — minimum 100 mm clearance. Tie-strap cable to manifold stud boss or block surface to prevent contact with hot metal under vibration.

g.title: W_WBO2_HTR
g.text: Splices to +12V coil/inj rail on engine side (ECU_12PIN[1]). Short stub — splice at rail, no ECU termination.

g.title: VVT_SOL
g.text: VW/Tyco Micro Timer 1.5mm Sealed — 2-pin (1J0 973 802 male on solenoid)
N205 camshaft adjustment valve. OEM solenoid: 06E 109 257 P. MaxxECU GPO 3 (CMC D4 = pin 16).

07K intake cam VVT actuator solenoid (N205 — camshaft adjustment valve 1). Solenoid OEM PN: 06E 109 257 P (covers 06E109257F/J/AA). Resistance: 5–9 Ω at 20°C. Connector series: VW/Tyco "Micro Timer" 1.5mm Sealed.
or Amazon B0D8FH4S8T (~170 mm leads, fits Jetta 2.5L).
Wire size: 22 AWG (0.35 mm²) adequate for solenoid drive current.
Pin 1 (+12V): switched +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]). Pin 2 (control): MaxxECU GPO 3 (CMC D4/pin 16) — LOW-SIDE switch (ECM grounds pin 2 to actuate).
MTune: Settings → Outputs → GPO 3 → Output type: Negative (low-side) → Function: PWM Solenoid
→ assign to Cam VVT control. Duty cycle 0% = cam retarded; higher DC = more advance.
Max advance: ~42° crank degrees. PWM frequency: 100–200 Hz.

GPO 3 signal terminates directly at CMC D4 (pin 16) at the engine-bay ECU — no bulkhead crossing. Flyback diode: 1N4007 at solenoid connector, cathode (banded end) to +12V pin (1), anode to GPO pin (2). Source: VW BGP/BGQ workshop manual (solenoid resistance, pin function);
automotivetechinfo.com 2010 Golf valve timing repair (connector PN confirmation);

g.title: BOOST_SOL
g.text: Same wiring as M52. GPO 1 (CMC B4/pin 8). +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]). Flyback diode: 1N4007 at connector, cathode (banded end) to +12V pin, anode to GPO 1 pin.

g.title: CLUTCH_POS_SENSOR
g.text: DCT Clutch Simulator Remote — CPS output
Engine-bay-mounted hydraulic clutch simulator. Same unit from Phase 1B (8HP swap) — no re-work at 07K swap.

Source: dctshifter.com/products/dct-clutch-simulator-remote and docs/vendor/dctshifter/DCT_Clutch_Simulator.md. Simulator lives in the engine bay, fed by the OEM E36 hydraulic clutch line from the cabin master cylinder. CPS output: +5V (CMC G1) / Signal (C2 AIN 5 = C2 pin G3) / SGND (CMC H1). All engine-bay-to- engine-bay — no firewall crossing. Unchanged at 07K swap.

g.title: W_CLUTCH_POS
g.text: Unchanged from M52 phase. See maxxecu-m52.wv W_CLUTCH_POS for full notes.

g.title: ECU_16PIN
g.text: MaxxECU M50 terminated harness — 16-pin aux breakout
GPO 3 (VVT solenoid — via CMC D4 direct; ETh motor = C2 H4/H2, NOT GPO)
GPO 2 (Fuel pump — CAN cmd → PMU16 O4)

g.title: W_CAN
g.text: Twisted pair. 120ohm at far end if bus run over 1 m. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: CAN_BUS_JUNCTION
g.text: MaxxECU CAN 1 (16-pin pins 9-10) feeds both the 8HP CAN harness and Gauge.S cluster. Bus speed: 500kbps. MaxxECU CAN 1 has built-in 120ohm terminator. Add 120ohm terminator at far end of bus if bus run over 1 meter total.

g.title: W_CAN_8HP
g.text: CAN junction → 8HP GEN1 harness. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: W_CAN_GAUGES
g.text: CAN junction → Gauge.S cluster. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: HP8_CAN
g.text: See harnesses/8hp-can.wv for full CAN + power wiring. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: GAUGES_CAN
g.text: Gauge.S E36 PNP cluster CAN input
Gauge.S receives MaxxECU Default 1.3 CAN output (500kbps). Enable in MTune: CAN :: Default CAN output :: MaxxECU Default 1.3. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: DCT_SHIFTER
g.text: DCT Shifter E36 (3-wire, no +12V supply needed)

Source: dctshifter.com/pages/installation — 3-wire only (no +12V). UP (Black) :: MaxxECU DIN 2 (Transmission UP shift). DOWN (Blue) :: MaxxECU DIN 1 (Transmission DOWN shift). GND (Brown) :: Sensor GND or chassis GND. MTune: Advanced :: 8HP :: Shifter type :: 8HP SEQ shifter. Under H2O engine-bay arch: 3 wires cross firewall via Maven Connector A (see harnesses/firewall-crossing-maven.wv pins 4/5/6). Unchanged from M52 phase logically — only the physical routing (cabin-to-engine-bay via Maven, not cabin-to-cabin).

g.title: W_SHIFTER
g.text: DCT Shifter paddle harness. Unchanged from M52 phase.

g.title: FLEX_FUEL
g.text: Flex fuel composition sensor — retain from M52, unchanged

GM 13577429 / Continental SE1004S. Pin A=+12V (system voltage — NOT 5V), Pin B=GND, Pin C=signal. Signal encodes ethanol % (frequency) and fuel temperature (pulse width) on one wire. Inline on fuel feed — position unchanged from M52. Zero wiring changes at Phase 3. +12V from coil/inj relay (ECU_12PIN[1]) — see connection block for correct routing.

g.title: W_FLEXFUEL
g.text: Retain flex fuel sensor if present. Unchanged from M52 phase.
